reasoning_content:
Wait, valkey-queue listens on port 6379 internally but I mapped 6380:6379. The app connects to VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PORT=6380, so that's fine. Actually the docker-compose uses port 6380 internally. Either way host port 6380 maps to container 6379 which is where valkey-server listens. Good.

Now set up .env and run pnpm install. Let me do that.

action.command:
cd /workspace && cp .env.defaults .env && cat >> .env <<'EOF'

# Added for manual local setup (guide)
VALKEY_PERSISTENT_SERVER=localhost
VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PORT=6380
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, secrets
p='/workspace/.env'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('SESSION_KEY=your_session_key_here', 'SESSION_KEY='+secrets.token_hex(32))
s=s.replace('CRYPTO_SECRET=your_crypto_secret_here', 'CRYPTO_SECRET='+secrets.token_hex(32))
s=s.replace('WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW=your_dev_password_here','WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW=devpassword123')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("done")
PY
grep -E '^(SESSION_KEY|CRYPTO_SECRET|WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW|VALKEY|DATABASE_URL)=' .env
